## Summary

For vLLM #49980, initialization-time sizing is correct and graph-stable but reserves request metadata for max_num_seqs multiplied by maximum local-attention chunk expansion. ChunkedLocalAttention advertises AttentionCGSupport.NEVER, so the affected long-prefill path can grow without invalidating captured addresses. Preserve a CPU regression for the virtual-batch expansion trigger and require GPU serving plus graph-mode validation before upstreaming.

Initialization-capacity candidate rejected; guarded grow-on-demand selected for publication.

Grow FlashInfer request and page metadata only on overflow, using exact observed sizes. Refuse pointer replacement after any CUDA-graph decode wrapper has been created; chunked-local attention advertises no CUDA-graph support, so its long-prefill path may grow safely. ## Summary

For vLLM #49980, initialization-time sizing is correct and graph-stable but reserves request metadata for max_num_seqs multiplied by maximum local-attention chunk expansion. The guarded grow-on-demand design is preferable: allocate only on overflow, size to observed virtual requests/pages, and refuse pointer replacement after any CUDA-graph decode wrapper exists. ChunkedLocalAttention advertises AttentionCGSupport.NEVER, so the affected long-prefill path can grow without invalidating captured addresses. | Candidate | Design | Assessment |
|---|---|---|

Refuse pointer replacement after CUDA-graph decode wrappers exist. | Meets the failure case with minimal steady-state cost. Chunked local attention reports no CUDA-graph support, making growth safe on the affected prefill path. |
